admin.editorsSeedDescription: Creates the @liravo_editors system account used for all platform-curated content. Run this first.

admin.listsSeedDescription: Creates 20 SEO-optimised reading lists owned by @liravo_editors. Requires books and editors account to already exist.
admin.promptsSeedDescription: Seeds 63 days of pre-written writing prompts starting from tomorrow. No AI keys required. Skips dates that already have a prompt.
admin.challengesSeedDescription: Creates 4 weekly writing challenges and 2 monthly challenges. Idempotent — skips titles that already exist.
admin.aiPromptsSeedDescription: Generates 7 days of AI writing prompts via DeepSeek/Gemini. Requires AI API keys. Use after the static seed to extend coverage.
admin.seedDescription: Initialise platform content for a fresh deployment. All actions are idempotent — safe to run multiple times.
admin.seedOrder: Run the numbered steps in sequence — each depends on the previous. The “Generate AI Prompts” action has no step number and can be run at any time after setup.
admin.themeDescription: Upload and activate custom themes. Themes are CSS variable overrides stored in the database. The active theme overrides the default light/dark values sitewide.
admin.writingChallengesDescription: Manage weekly/monthly writing challenges. Daily prompts are auto-generated via cron.
admin.noPromptsGeneratedYetTriggerTheCronToPop: No prompts generated yet. Trigger the cron to populate.
